units.text: Clarification of the Meaning of Islam
The questioner, who signed her name as (M), says: Please clarify the meaning of Islam?

Islam means: submission to Allah through tawhid (monotheism), and compliance to Him through obedience, with humility and submissiveness. This is the meaning of Islam. It is said: 'So-and-so aslama to so-and-so,' meaning: he humbled himself to him, complied with him, and gave him what he requested. Thus, Islam means: humility to Allah, compliance to Allah by affirming His Oneness, sincerity to Him, obeying His commands, and abandoning His prohibitions. This is Islam. Allah, the Exalted, says: ⟦Q1⟧ [Aal 'Imran:19]. The Muslim is called a Muslim because he is compliant to Allah, humble and obedient to Him, Glorified be He, in doing what He commands and leaving what He forbids.

Islam is also applied to all that Allah and His Messenger have enjoined, such as prayer, fasting, Hajj, faith, and so on. All of it is called Islam, as Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says: ⟦Q2⟧ [Aal 'Imran:19]. And the Exalted says: ⟦Q3⟧ [Al-Ma'idah:3]. And Glorified is He, says: ⟦Q4⟧ [Aal 'Imran:85].

So the Muslim is the one who complies with the command of Allah in speech, action, and creed. Islam is compliance with the command of Allah, submission to the command of Allah, and humility to the command of Allah from all aspects. Yes.
Presenter: May Allah reward you with good, Your Eminence the Shaykh.
